plan: Drive: from City of Delta, about 60 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.51081, -122.9895, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 230 m W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Jan, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 2-8, Region 2. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R2A-duck-drive-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 2-8: about 1,369 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.27 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.2 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).

R2A-grouse-drive-0002.name: By Mamquam River
R2A-grouse-drive-0002.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).
R2A-grouse-drive-0002.parkWhat: pull off on Mamquam River FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: Road: Mamquam River FSR, 4.7 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
5 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
16 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: sooty (blue), ruffed and spruce: 10 (30) in aggregate
No row in the Region 2 table, so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

plan: Drive: from City of Delta, about 84 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.67822, -122.91158, pull off on Mamquam River FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Mamquam River FSR stretch, 4.7 km one way. About 93 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 2-7, Region 2. Season: grouse Sept 10 to Dec 15 and more rows (synopsis page 28, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
